            return False
        i1 = positions[0]
        im = positions[-1]
        if k * (im - i1 + 1) <= m:
            return True
        return False

    # Find all obtainable characters
    obtainable_categories = [char for char in unique_chars if is_obtainable(char)]

    # Sort the obtainable categories
    obtainable_categories.sort()
